data.one_liner: Segment display widget for Flutter supporting 7, 14, and 16 segment displays with customizable styles
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets to render numeric and alphanumeric characters using segment displays. Supports custom segment shapes, colors, spacing, and decimal/colon characters.
use_when: You need a digital clock or numeric display with classic segment look
You want to customize segment colors or shapes
You need support for 7, 14, or 16 segment displays in a Flutter app
avoid_when: You require a fully animated or physics-based segment animation
You need a high-performance, low-level rendering of segments for very large numbers
strengths: Supports multiple segment types and custom styles
Always-visible disabled dividers and custom character maps
weaknesses: Limited to segment display shapes, not arbitrary graphics
No integration with state management or theming beyond basic colors
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, use widget
data.minimal_example:
SevenSegmentDisplay(
  value: "123",
  size: 12.0,
  characterSpacing: 10.0,
  backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
  segmentStyle: HexSegmentStyle(
    enabledColor: Colors.red,
    disabledColor: Colors.red.withOpacity(0.15),
  ),
)
